description: Academic note metadata. The actual content blob (LaTeX source, compiled PDF, etc.) is stored on the Ring; this PDS record holds metadata and a ringRef pointer. Versioned — each edit creates a new record with parentNote pointing to the previous version.

sessionUri.description: AT URI of the app.changala.session this note belongs to.

ringRef.description: Reference to the content blob on the Ring.

version.description: Monotonically increasing version number. Starts at 1.

parentNote.description: AT URI of the previous version of this note.

summary.description: Short summary or description of the note.
